title: Household Charge Calculation — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit
content:
*Fee schedule calculation note, Specimen Collection Appointments.*

## Clause

The household charge on a collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit is the additional-patient fee of 35.00 multiplied by the number of additional household members drawn at the visit, posted as one assessed additional-patient fee rounded to the cent. A visit that drew no additional household member carries no household charge.

## Formation of the charge

The household charge is formed in one fixed order:

1. each member's rate is formed first — the member rate (the additional-patient fee of 35.00), together with any amount charged on each member's rate;
2. that per-member rate is multiplied by the number of members counted, which is the number of additional household members drawn at the visit;
3. any amount charged on the household as a whole is then added.

A visit that drew no additional household member is charged nothing at all, and the household charge is rounded to the cent only once, at the end.

The number of additional household members is the figure on the visit record; it never exceeds the published maximum of 3 for the visit type.

## Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

| Additional household members drawn | Per-member rate | Members counted | Household charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | — | — | None |
| 1 | 35.00 | 1 | 35.00 |
| 2 | 35.00 | 2 | 70.00 |
| 3 | 35.00 | 3 | 105.00 |

**Point of judgement.** The patient whose order the visit collects is not an additional household member; a visit at which only the patient was drawn carries no household charge.
